description.value:
Whether recovered from ancient ruins or built through relentless tinkering, the devices at the heart of the Teleportation Technique let a scout tear open brief portals wherever the fight demands. Followers of this path treat the battlefield less as a fixed space and more as a set of doors waiting to be opened.

They strike, vanish, and reappear somewhere the enemy never expected, using linked rifts to redirect attacks, punish anyone caught between them, and even hurl incoming danger back at a different foe entirely. To fight a Teleportation specialist is to never be quite sure where the next blow will come from.
